title: Restructure website to 3-5 pages from current single-page layout

requirements.summary: Analyze the current single-page layout and restructure it into 3-5 separate routable pages with distinct URLs
acceptanceCriteria: Current 7 sections are reorganized into 3-5 logical page groupings
Each new page has its own route (e.g., /about, /menu, /contact)
Navigation structure allows users to move between pages
All existing content and functionality is preserved across the new page structure

file_operations.description: Transform HomePage from a composition of 7 sections into a focused landing page containing only HeroSection and a brief introduction. This becomes the new home page at route /
Create AboutPage component that combines WhySection and TestimonialsSection to tell the bakery's story and showcase customer feedback. This page will be accessible at route /about
Create MenuPage component that displays MenuHighlightsSection with the product grid and menu download functionality. This page will be accessible at route /menu

Create CelebrationsPage component that displays CelebrationSection showcasing the four celebration occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, gifts, corporate). This page will be accessible at route /celebrations
Create ContactPage component that combines LocationSection and FinalCTASection to provide contact information, hours, and a final call-to-action. This page will be accessible at route /contact

requirements.summary: Update the Header component navigation to include links to all new pages while maintaining existing admin button and Order Now CTA
acceptanceCriteria: Header displays navigation links to all 3-5 pages
Current admin button and Order Now CTA remain functional
Navigation is responsive and works on mobile devices
Active page is visually indicated in the navigation

file_operations.description: Add navigation menu with links to Home (/), About (/about), Menu (/menu), Celebrations (/celebrations), and Contact (/contact). Use React Router's Link and useLocation to highlight the active page. Maintain the existing admin button for authenticated admins and Order Now CTA. Ensure mobile-responsive navigation (hamburger menu or horizontal scroll). Update the Order Now button to navigate to /contact instead of scrolling to a section

requirements.summary: Update React Router configuration in App.tsx to support the new multi-page structure with routes for each of the 3-5 pages while maintaining the existing /admin route
acceptanceCriteria: All 3-5 new pages have defined routes
Navigation between pages works without page refresh

file_operations.description: Add Route definitions for the new pages: / (HomePage), /about (AboutPage), /menu (MenuPage), /celebrations (CelebrationsPage), and /contact (ContactPage). Import the new page components. Maintain the existing /admin route. Ensure all routes are wrapped in the Layout component with Header and Footer

requirements.summary: Ensure internal links and CTAs work correctly across the new multi-page structure, updating section-scroll behavior to page navigation where appropriate
acceptanceCriteria: Order Now buttons navigate to the appropriate page with location information
All CTAs across pages function correctly
No broken links or navigation errors

file_operations.description: Update the two CTA buttons: 'Order Now' button should navigate to /contact using React Router Link, and 'Visit Us' button should also navigate to /contact. Remove any scroll-to-section functionality
Update the Order Now button to navigate to /contact using React Router Link instead of scrolling to a location section. Ensure the background image and styling remain unchanged
Verify that the View Full Menu and Download Menu buttons continue to work correctly with the dialog functionality. No navigation changes needed as this is internal functionality
